title: The `DeeDeeExperiment` User's Guide
text: Differential expression analysis (DEA) functional enrichment analysis (FEA) core steps transcriptomic workflows, helping researchers detect interpret biological differences conditions. However, number conditions (defined complex experimental designs) analysis tools increases, managing outputs analyses across multiple contrasts becomes increasingly overwhelming. challenge amplified single-cell RNA-seq, pseudo-bulk analyses generate numerous results tables across cell types contrasts, making challenging organize, explore, reproduce findings, even experienced users - invite see detail dedicated companion vignette single cell data. address issues, introduce DeeDeeExperiment class, S4 object extends widely adopted SingleCellExperiment class Bioconductor. DeeDeeExperiment provides structured consistent framework integrating DEA FEA results alongside core expression data metadata. centralizing results single container, DeeDeeExperiment enables users retrieve, explore, manage analysis results efficiently across multiple contrasts. vignette introduces class structure, demonstrates create work DeeDeeExperiment objects, walks typical RNA-seq workflow using class.

title: The `DeeDeeExperiment` User's Guide
text: DeeDeeExperiment class inherits core Bioconductor SingleCellExperiment object. means inherits slots, methods, compatibility tools built SingleCellExperiment, introducing additional components streamline downstream analysis.  Specifically, DeeDeeExperiment two new slots: dea : SimpleList stores results differential expression analysis (DEA), along relevant metadata. includes: used False Discovery Rate (FDR) log2 fold change (LFC) thresholds (specified). Meta info related LFC p-value. package used generate DE results (e.g. DEseq2, edgeR limma…). pointer original DE result object, kept metadata DeeDeeExperiment object. main columns use DEA addition feature identifier (log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj) also stored rowData DeeDeeExperiment object. fea : SimpleList stores results functional enrichment analysis (FEA), along relevant metadata. includes: name associated DEA contrast. FEA name. GeneTonicList-compatible set shaken_results (ready used GeneTonic). enrichment tool used generate results (e.g. topGO, clusterProfiler...). copy original enrichment result object. SimpleList slot type bring advantage storing DEA/FEA related metadata (e.g., design formula) directly metadata/mcols.

title: How to use DeeDeeExperiment with single-cell data
text: vignette, illustrate integrate Differential Expression Analysis (DEA) results generated muscat framework DeeDeeExperiment object. example, use publicly available dataset Kang, et al. “Multiplexed droplet single-cell RNA-sequencing using natural genetic variation”, published Nature Biotechnology, December 2017 Kang et al. (2017) data made available via ExperimentHub Bioconductor package SingleCellExperiment object containing scRNA-seq data PBMCs obtained 8 lupus patients IFNβ stimulation. demonstration purposes adapt parts code original muscat vignette) begin creating ExperimentHub instance, provides access curated datasets stored Bioconductor cloud. Using query(), filter available records entries matching keyword “Kang”, load dataset interest using accession ID “EH2259”. running muscat, perform standard single-cell preprocessing steps: removing undetected genes, filtering low-quality cells using scater, removing lowly expressed genes. prepare data muscat. package expects certain format input SCE. Specifically, following cell metadata (colData) columns provided: sample_id : unique sample identifiers cluster_id : subpopulation (cluster) assignments group_id : experimental group/condition compute UMAP visualization. dataset already includes precomputed TSNE coordinates, run UMAP . aggregate measurements sample (cluster) obtain pseudobulk data construct contrast matrix pseudobulk data assembled, can now test differential state (DS) using pbDS Now integrate output muscat muscat_list_for_dde() transform format accepted DeeDeeExperiment Finally results can directly added new dde object, existing one. DeeDeeExperiment objects, can call specific methods extract/retrieve/integrate information. can extract names DEA included: Also, can directly retrieve content DEA typing General info DEA performed can shown getDEAInfo() add information scenario investigation, can use addScenarioInfo(). can e.g. later processed contextually relevant bit Large Language Model used interact object. usual, summary() method can called obtain quick overview performed analyses.

S100B PRMT2 #> rowData names(2): ENSEMBL SYMBOL #> colnames(26820): AAACATACAATGCC-1 AAACATACATTTCC-1 ... TTTGCATGGTTTGG-1 #>   TTTGCATGTCTTAC-1 #> colData names(3): cluster_id sample_id group_id #> reducedDimNames(1): TSNE #> mainExpName: NULL #> altExpNames(0): # compute UMAP using 1st 20 PCs sce <- runUMAP(sce, pca = 20) # aggregate by cell type pb <- aggregateData(   sce,   assay = "counts",   fun = "sum",   by = c("cluster_id", "sample_id") )  assayNames(pb) #> [1] "B cells"           "CD14+ Monocytes"   "CD4 T cells"       #> [4] "CD8 T cells"       "Dendritic cells"   "FCGR3A+ Monocytes" #> [7] "Megakaryocytes"    "NK cells" # construct design & contrast matrix ei <- metadata(sce)$experiment_info mm <- model.matrix(~ 0 + ei$group_id) dimnames(mm) <- list(ei$sample_id, levels(ei$group_id)) contrast <- makeContrasts("stim-ctrl", levels = mm) # run DS analysis muscat_res <- pbDS(pb, design = mm, contrast = contrast) #>   |                                                                              |                                                                      |   0%  |                                                                              |=========                                                             |  12%  |                                                                              |==================                                                    |  25%  |                                                                              |==========================                                            |  38%  |                                                                              |===================================                                   |  50%  |                                                                              |============================================                          |  62%  |                                                                              |====================================================                  |  75%  |                                                                              |=============================================================         |  88%  |                                                                              |======================================================================| 100%  names(muscat_res$table[["stim-ctrl"]]) #> [1] "B cells"           "CD14+ Monocytes"   "CD4 T cells"       #> [4] "CD8 T cells"       "Dendritic cells"   "FCGR3A+ Monocytes" #> [7] "Megakaryocytes"    "NK cells" # preparing the results as muscat list muscat_list <- muscat_list_for_dde(res = list(`stim-ctrl` = muscat_res),                                    padj_col = "p_adj.loc") # create dde dde <- DeeDeeExperiment(sce = sce,                         de_results = muscat_list) dde #> class: DeeDeeExperiment  #> dim: 7118 26820  #> metadata(3): experiment_info singlecontrast version #> assays(2): counts logcounts #> rownames(7118): NOC2L HES4 ... title: DeeDeeExperiment: An S4 Class for managing and exploring omics analysis results
text: DeeDeeExperiment class extends core Bioconductor SingleCellExperiment object, retaining structure, methods, compatibility existing tools. addition, introduces new components designed simplify enhance downstream analysis. Specifically, DeeDeeExperiment two new slots: dea : slot stores results differential expression analysis (DEA), along relevant metadata (currently supports results DESeq2, edgeR, limma, muscat) fea : slot stores results functional enrichment analysis (FEA), along relevant metadata (currently supports results topGO, clusterProfiler, enrichR, gProfiler, fgsea, gsea, DAVID, output GeneTonic shakers)
